name: windows-eaglepack-library-importer
title: Windows Parity Handoff: Lossless .eaglepack & .library Material Package Importer
description: Mirror macOS lossless material package import (.eaglepack ZIP archives, extracted pack dirs, .library bundles, and picker-selected .zip exports) in Windows Rust Core + Tauri + React UI: preserve multi-level folder hierarchies & folder colors, titles, tags, star/rating, annotations, source URLs, original btime/mtime timestamps, and offline .url web bookmark thumbnails while filtering deleted items, sidecar thumbnails, and Zip-Slip path traversal; wire unified drag-and-drop (gallery/sidebar/moodboard/top shelf), Ctrl+Shift+I shortcut, sidebar folder import icon, Settings -> Library import action, and CLI/MCP ingest.
creator: CharTyr
notes: Keep Windows changes strictly under windows/. Reference macOS implementation in Sources/CharkleCore/Media/EaglePackImporter.swift and LiveCharkleEngine.swift for exact field mapping, edge cases, and security guards.
